answer.held_back_by: Honestly telling people their thing would fail at the start, then keeping on being the honest guy. The system quietly capped me and I only found out at the end, so it was less my effort and more a hidden ceiling and the party's own idea of me.
answer.ending_fair_why: I walked every block three times and still lost with 48.2%, and the card says it was never about me. Realistic maybe, but after all that effort it felt like my choices did not matter, and I never got the pilot payoff I was waiting for.
answer.chase_next: Permanent Secretary, the top of the service, since the file said that was my ceiling. I want to see what happens if I keep my mouth shut early on and stay in the service instead of going into politics.
answer.play_again_why: Forty-plus years of taps is long on a phone in bed. I'd come back for a different path in a few days, but not right now.
